description: Armenia: Lakes and Reservoirs (ERICA) is a dataset listed in Open Data Armenia, an open data portal (CKAN) run by a civil-society initiative, published or maintained by Scientific Network for the Caucasus Mountain Regions. The layer is map of lakes and reservoirs in Armenia, coded using ERICA (European Rivers and Catchment)coding system, which was designed for European Environment Agency. Refer to the Features section in the metadata for copyright information. Coverage: Scientific Network for the Caucasus Mountain Regions. The publisher named on the listing is Scientific Network for the Caucasus Mountain Regions. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP, JPEG, PDF, PNG. The listing shows 2023-07-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opendata-am.
